resources.string: Install Shizuku, then return here. MM Auto handles the app download and installation; King Installer is not needed.
Open Shizuku and tap Start. If this is your first time, open the pairing help below. Return when Shizuku says it is running. You may need to start it again after restarting your phone.
Tap Allow MM Auto, then approve the permission request.
In Shizuku, open Authorized applications and enable MM Auto, then return here.
Continue here, then tap Install in the Android window. Your existing app data is kept. After installation, check your car screen.
How do I pair and start it?

1. Connect to Wi-Fi. In phone Settings, enable Developer options and USB debugging. If Developer options is hidden, search Settings for your OS version/build number and tap it repeatedly until enabled.

2. In Shizuku, tap Pairing. Open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code. Enter that code in the Shizuku notification.

3. Return to Shizuku and tap Start. Wait for “Shizuku is running”. If stuck waiting, turn Wireless debugging off and on, then retry.

After restarting the phone, Shizuku needs to be started again. Setting names vary by phone.
One extra setting on Xiaomi / POCO / Redmi

In Developer options, enable USB debugging (Security settings). This is separate from USB debugging and allows additional ADB actions. MM Auto cannot check or enable this switch for you. If the installer asks for Install via USB, enable that too. Return here when done.
After repair, check Android Auto → Customize launcher for MM Tube or MM IPTV without “Audio”. A successful source check alone does not confirm visibility.
Open Shizuku or Developer options from your phone manually, then return here.
Installation needs a check. Open Help.
